title: Design Thinking for Data-Driven App Development
standfirst: Design-thinking methods applied to building applications where the data itself is the product.
instructor: Prof. Bala Ramadurai & Prof. Prathap Haridoss

description_paragraphs: This course enables students to apply agile methods in software development, design applications using design thinking principles, develop Android apps, collaborate using Git-based version control, and understand the basics of marketing and customer support through web platforms.

In-course project: The in-course project is integrated into the course and not offered separately. Students work in teams across iterative phases to identify real-world user problems, build empathy, analyze root causes, and develop innovative solutions using design thinking. Through continuous testing, feedback, and refinement - along with elements of UX design, website development, and digital marketing - students progress from problem discovery to launching a functional application, demonstrating an end-to-end product development approach.
faculty: Prof. Bala Ramadurai, Consultant and Guest Faculty, IIT Madras
Prof. Prathap Haridoss, Department of Metallurgical and Materials Engineering, IIT Madras

weeks_text.label: Week 1
weeks_text.text: Introduction to design thinking; Human-centered design; Stages and principles of design thinking.

weeks_text.label: Week 2
weeks_text.text: Persona creation; Empathy and user profiling; Customer journey mapping; Understanding user needs and design paradoxes.

weeks_text.label: Week 3
weeks_text.text: Empathy techniques; Identifying meaningful problems; "How Might We" (HMW) framing.

weeks_text.label: Week 4
weeks_text.text: Problem analysis; Root cause analysis (multi-why); Handling conflicts.

weeks_text.label: Week 5
weeks_text.text: Ideation techniques; Brainstorming; TRIZ methodology; Converting ideas into concepts.

weeks_text.label: Week 6
weeks_text.text: Prototyping and testing; Gathering user feedback; Iterative refinement; Digital marketing strategies.

weeks_text.label: Week 7
weeks_text.text: Prototyping types; Website development basics; UX design fundamentals.

weeks_text.label: Week 8
weeks_text.text: Iterative design cycles; Advanced empathy and analysis; Conflict resolution frameworks; Tools like Figma.

weeks_text.label: Week 9
weeks_text.text: Solution development; Refining and implementing design ideas.

weeks_text.label: Week 10
weeks_text.text: Testing and iteration; Product demos; Feedback-driven improvements.

weeks_text.label: Week 11
weeks_text.text: Advanced analysis; Human factors in design; Usability considerations.

weeks_text.label: Week 12
weeks_text.text: Product launch strategies; Intrapreneurship and innovation; Future opportunities in design and product development.
